user_instruction: User authorized up to ten new suitable accessible constructs beyond existing eleven GenBank candidates; no Addgene authenticated access.
scientific_scope: Public benign fluorescent reporters, multi-gene devices, tagged constructs, pigment enzyme expression; source parts are not necessarily complete plasmids.
approval_contract: Candidates only until anonymous API confirms published sequence plus source metadata, licensing, benign scope and annotations. Separate T02 scientific admission needed. T07 pre-score family/ref approval not waived.

candidates.title: Temperature-dependent mRFP1/sfGFP reporter device
candidates.caveat: Two fluorescent reporters with CI857/PhlF regulation; avoid treating same-family proteins as independent.

candidates.title: Light-responsive LacI/YF1/FixJ/GFP device
candidates.caveat: Multi-part regulatory GFP device; check actual distinct coding features.

candidates.title: mCerulean3–6xHis T7 expression cassette
candidates.caveat: Small tagged fluorescent coding construct, not whole plasmid.

candidates.title: pET-28 GfasPurple chromoprotein plasmid
candidates.caveat: Full colored-protein expression plasmid; verify source labels.

candidates.title: pET-28 TyrBm tyrosinase pigment plasmid
candidates.caveat: Pigment biosynthesis, ordinary benign enzyme; verify precise full plasmid.

candidates.title: hUBC–tdTomato reporter cassette
candidates.caveat: Reporter cassette, not full plasmid; verify component annotations.

candidates.title: sfGFP–PETase secretion reporter cassette
candidates.caveat: Check if complete fusion exists in deposited source before fusion evaluation.

candidates.title: Nickel-responsive sfGFP reporter cassette
candidates.caveat: Inducible fluorescent reporter; not full plasmid.

candidates.title: pET-28 OptoLacI/YF1/FixJ/GFP light device
candidates.caveat: Related to 252QAUN3; assign shared independence cluster.

candidates.title: BslA–dCBM fusion coating reporter unit
candidates.caveat: Confirm benign material coating context, not pathogen/adhesion or unknown biofilm function.

candidates.title: Nitrite sensor dual reporter insert
candidates.caveat: Candidate only: validate harmless components, sequence annotations and role.

candidates.title: J23105/thsr/PphsA342/sfGFP reporter cassette
candidates.caveat: Catalog description mismatch; manual feature check required.

candidates.title: T7 GfasPurple reporter expression cassette
candidates.caveat: Related GfasPurple sequence to 25NPQIRU; not independent.

candidates.title: pSB_Bs3C luxABCDE and RFP luminescence reporter vector
candidates.caveat: Public complete vector; long luxABCDE cassette, establish independent families separately.

candidates.title: pS1300 RcTAL–eGFP fusion construct
candidates.caveat: Deposition claims a GFP fusion; verify full annotated part and exact fusion bounds.
